title: HOLD-LC-001 official joint-search statistic owner candidate
question: Does the official joint Fermi-GBM and LIGO/Virgo analysis provide a source-owned finite association statistic and background calibration that can fill any HOLD-LC-001 statistical-owner fields without being mistaken for a continuous detector-timing likelihood?
method: Read the official LIGO document page and its linked primary PDF for the GBM Targeted Search and joint-analysis method, recording bounded locators and retrieval date.

Extract the documented GBM signal-versus-background log-likelihood ratio, the joint association ranking statistic, the minimum time-offset binning and the empirical background-to-p-value construction without importing event-level matrix values.

Crosswalk those objects against the hash-pinned HOLD-LC-001 candidate-neutral Delta_t_det and response-owner contracts, distinguishing a finite association-search owner candidate from the missing pulse-onset, detector-to-geocenter and intrinsic-lag map.
Run an adversarial ownership and leakage review; preserve T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and stopped-loop rules, and do not score microscopic candidates or populate F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Official finite association-search statistic and background-calibration semantics only; no event-level response values, continuous timing likelihood, covariance, candidate map, score, continuum limit or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 P1 statistical-owner intake refinement; no change to T-054/T-059 methods, owner order or promotion firewalls.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The official document describes offline joint GBM/LIGO-Virgo searches and states that the analysis implements a refined statistical approach using GW astrophysical probabilities and GBM visibility of the GW sky localization.
official_sources.owner_boundary: Document-level scope only; the page does not itself provide the HOLD-LC-001 event likelihood or response/calibration map.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The Targeted Search uses a log-likelihood ratio Lambda for a similar-spectrum signal versus background-only, selects the best Lambda spectrum per bin after filtering, and constructs the joint ranking R = pastro times pvisible divided by absolute time offset times GBM FAR, with a 64 ms minimum offset. Search significance is calibrated by applying the same search parameters to independently selected O1/O2 background times and mapping R to an empirical p-value.
official_sources.owner_boundary: This is a source-documented finite association-search method. It is not, by itself, a detector-to-geocenter propagation algorithm, a continuous Delta_t_det likelihood, a covariance decomposition or an intrinsic-emission-lag law.

gbm_targeted_search.meaning: log-likelihood ratio for a signal with a similar spectrum versus the null hypothesis of background only
gbm_targeted_search.operation: select the model spectrum with highest Lambda for each search bin after phosphorescent-bin removal and overlap merging
gbm_targeted_search.background_role: same search parameters and spectral-template-specific background distributions

inputs: absolute GW-to-gamma candidate time offset Delta_t
joint_association_search.background_calibration: random O1/O2 times selected independently with respect to GBM, with the same search parameters; p_i = N(R > R_i) / N
joint_association_search.role: finite retrospective association ranking and empirical background calibration

partial_fields_supported: A source-documented GBM signal-versus-background log-likelihood-ratio object for a search-bin statistic.
A source-documented finite joint-association ranking statistic and its background-based empirical p-value construction.
An explicit minimum time-offset binning rule for that search statistic and a separation of O1/O2 background populations.
not_supported_for_hold_lc_001_admission: A continuous event-level Delta_t_det likelihood for the GBM pulse onset relative to the GW merger.
The detector-to-geocenter correction, spacecraft position/attitude interpolation, Earth-orientation convention and decomposed propagation uncertainty.
The response-segment validity/interpolation, gain calibration and response-matrix uncertainty linkage for the frozen event products.
A joint covariance including GW merger time, GBM onset/background, calibration and shared source/selection terms.
An intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or a sealed prospective holdout and immutable candidate-neutral scorer.

checks.detail: The primary PDF explicitly defines Lambda as a signal-versus-background log-likelihood ratio, R as the joint ranking statistic, the 64 ms minimum offset and the empirical background p-value construction.

The source supplies a finite association-search statistic and background calibration candidate, but it does not fill the continuous timing, response, covariance, propagation or nuisance fields required for HOLD-LC-001 admission.
The published search statistic and empirical p-values remain retrospective method provenance and receive no prospective holdout or candidate-score credit.
The established T-054 forward method, additive T-059 inverse method, owner order and parked-loop registry are unchanged.

finding: The official joint-search paper supplies a genuine finite source-owned association statistic and an empirical background calibration procedure, which advances the statistical-owner inventory beyond a published central timing summary. Its R statistic ranks associations using a binned time offset, GW astrophysical probability, GBM visibility and FAR; it does not define the continuous detector-level Delta_t_det likelihood, detector-to-geocenter correction, response validity, covariance or intrinsic-lag map required for HOLD-LC-001. The branch therefore remains an owner candidate with admission stopped, while all response values and microscopic-candidate scoring remain locked.
decision_reason: This is a new official joint-search methodology with explicit likelihood-ratio, ranking and background semantics. It partially fills a statistical-owner slot while making the remaining continuous timing and calibration boundary precise; it is not a repeated generic owner search and does not replace either research method.
decision_scope: T0 official finite association-statistic provenance and partial statistical-owner crosswalk only; no event likelihood, dynamic identification, physical identity or empirical prediction.
assumptions: The cited LIGO document and PDF represent the documented joint-search method at the recorded retrieval date.
The symbol R and its background p-value construction can be recorded as source methodology without treating the published search as a prospective holdout.
The exact local HOLD-LC-001 contracts and parent hashes remain authoritative for continuous timing, calibration and map admission.
A binned association ranking can be compared to the required timing estimator only as a crosswalk, not as an automatic substitution.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned mapping from the event-level GBM pulse estimator and response products to a continuous Delta_t_det likelihood.
The detector-to-geocenter propagation algorithm, spacecraft-state interpolation, Earth orientation and uncertainty decomposition.
Event-specific response validity/interpolation, gain calibration and response-matrix uncertainty linkage.
A joint covariance or likelihood including GW merger time, GBM onset/background, calibration and shared source/selection terms.
An intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law, sealed prospective holdout and immutable candidate-neutral scorer.

adversarial_review.check: Could R be inserted as the continuous Delta_t_det likelihood for the event?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: R is a finite association ranking with a binned offset, FAR and visibility inputs, not an event-level continuous timing law.

adversarial_review.check: Could the empirical p_i background calibration replace a source-owned covariance or component uncertainty budget?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the background ranking calibrates association significance and does not decompose timing, calibration or shared-source covariance.

adversarial_review.check: Could the absolute candidate time offset in R be treated as the detector-to-geocenter corrected pulse onset?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the paper's search offset is not the missing spacecraft-state propagation algorithm or its uncertainty.

adversarial_review.check: Could the published O1/O2 background distributions count as a prospective holdout for a new candidate scorer?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the method and event are retrospective; PROS-LOCK-001 remains empty.

adversarial_review.check: Could the R inputs be treated as frozen event-owner quantities without their versioned source, uncertainty and linkage?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: their source versions, uncertainty and event linkage must be frozen before any reuse.

adversarial_review.check: Could this official search statistic replace the established T-054 or T-059 method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive T-061 statistical-owner candidate and preserves the existing methods, owner order and parked-loop rules.

boundary: EXP-001310 is a T0 official finite association-search crosswalk. It does not admit a HOLD-LC-001 continuous likelihood, covariance, detector-to-geocenter implementation, response value, calibration-validity rule, intrinsic-emission nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 primary official joint-search methodology and bounded formula extraction; no event-level model or statistical reproduction
next_action: Treat the P1900186 Lambda/R method as a partial statistical-owner candidate only. Seek its versioned event inputs, response/calibration linkage and continuous pulse-onset/geocenter uncertainty owner before any F_reg construction; keep response values, timing likelihood, covariance, intrinsic-lag scoring and prospective credit locked, and continue unchanged T-054 owner intake in parallel.
stop_or_redesign: If the association statistic cannot be linked to a versioned event input and owner, retain it as official method provenance and do not promote it to HOLD-LC-001 admission.
If a later implementation changes the time-offset binning, FAR/background construction or p-visible inputs after target disclosure, version it anew and invalidate prospective credit.
If the continuous timing likelihood and covariance remain absent, report finite association evidence only rather than substituting R for Delta_t_det.
If no admitted dynamic observable separates a static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
non_claims: The official Lambda and R statistics are not a continuous event-level Delta_t_det likelihood or covariance.
The empirical background p-value procedure is not a detector-to-geocenter propagation correction or intrinsic-emission-lag law.
No response matrix value, calibration-validity rule, candidate score or prospective holdout is admitted.
No microscopic dynamics, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this is an additive statistical-owner crosswalk, not a replacement.
